diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~16% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. A few outliers stand out (3 points, ~3% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.135), which favours a robust combination.
